expect: valentines/PL `rule_type: fixed` yields no date in 2026
why: spec 009 AC-2's third rule: an occasion row whose `rule_type` the evaluator cannot date. A `fixed` 30 February parses — `OccasionRuleSchema` bounds `day` at 31, not by month — and `occasionDate()` returns `null` for it every year, so the occasion would silently drop off every calendar. Only `none` may be undated (a name day, AC-11).
